hpi: Intra-abdominal hypertension (IAH) is defined as an intra-abdominal pressure (IAP) greater than 12 mmHg. It is a common complication in critically ill patients, particularly those with trauma, sepsis, or abdominal surgery. IAH can lead to abdominal compartment syndrome (ACS), which can cause organ dysfunction and failure. Early recognition and management of IAH are crucial to prevent progression to ACS. Treatment options include fluid resuscitation, decompression, and monitoring of intra-abdominal pressure.
